title: 1987 TOPPS BASEBALL #466 KAL DANIELS CINCINNATI REDS
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a vintage 1987 Topps Tiffany baseball card featuring Kal Daniels of the Cincinnati Reds. The card is an original licensed reprint made of card stock with a thickness of 20 Pt. It is part of the Topps set, with a red parallel/variety. The card is in standard size and showcases a Major League Baseball player from the 1987 season.
